post.description: 根据指定的日期范围和部门，统计分析 AI 代码占比

get.description:
获取最新统计结果
---
tags:
  - stats
summary: 获取最新统计结果
description: 获取数据库中最新的统计记录
responses:
  200:
    description: 获取成功
    schema:
      type: object
      properties:
        success:
          type: boolean
          example: true
        data:
          type: object
          description: 统计记录详情
  404:
    description: 暂无统计数据
    schema:
      $ref: '#/definitions/ErrorResponse'

获取统计历史记录
---
tags:
  - stats
summary: 获取统计历史记录
description: 获取指定日期范围内的统计历史记录
parameters:
  - in: query
    name: start
    type: string
    format: date-time
    description: 开始日期（可选）
  - in: query
    name: end
    type: string
    format: date-time
    description: 结束日期（可选）
  - in: query
    name: limit
    type: integer
    default: 100
    description: 返回记录数量限制
responses:
  200:
    description: 获取成功
    schema:
      type: object
      properties:
        success:
          type: boolean
          example: true
        data:
          type: array
          description: 历史记录列表

获取指定统计详情
---
tags:
  - stats
summary: 获取指定统计详情
description: 根据统计ID获取详细统计信息
parameters:
  - in: path
    name: stat_id
    type: string
    required: true
    description: 统计记录ID
responses:
  200:
    description: 获取成功
    schema:
      type: object
      properties:
        success:
          type: boolean
          example: true
        data:
          type: object
          description: 统计记录详情
  404:
    description: 统计记录不存在
    schema:
      $ref: '#/definitions/ErrorResponse'

获取项目列表（按部门分组）
---
tags:
  - projects
summary: 获取项目列表
description: 获取所有项目，按部门分组展示
responses:
  200:
    description: 获取成功
    schema:
      type: object
      properties:
        success:
          type: boolean
          example: true
        data:
          type: object
          properties:
            departments:
              type: array
              items:
                type: string
              description: 部门列表
              example: ["backend", "frontend"]
            repos_by_department:
              type: object
              description: 各部门下的仓库列表
              example:
                backend: ["repo1", "repo2"]
                frontend: ["web-repo"]
            all_repos:
              type: array
              items:
                type: string
              description: 所有仓库列表

获取部门列表
---
tags:
  - projects
summary: 获取部门列表
description: 获取所有部门名称
responses:
  200:
    description: 获取成功
    schema:
      type: object
      properties:
        success:
          type: boolean
          example: true
        data:
          type: object
          properties:
            departments:
              type: array
              items:
                type: string
              example: ["backend", "frontend", "mobile"]
              description: 部门名称列表

post.description:
上传 metrics 数据
---
tags:
  - worker-metrics
summary: 上传 metrics 数据
description: Git-AI 客户端批量上传 metrics 事件数据
security:
  - Bearer: []
parameters:
  - in: body
    name: body
    description: Metrics 数据批次
    required: true
    schema:
      type: object
      properties:
        v:
          type: integer
          description: 协议版本
        events:
          type: array
          description: 事件列表
          items:
            type: object
responses:
  200:
    description: 处理成功
    schema:
      type: object
      properties:
        errors:
          type: array
          description: 错误列表（空表示全部成功）
          items:
            type: object
            properties:
              index:
                type: integer
                description: 事件索引
              error:
                type: string
                description: 错误信息
